verdict.rationale: Messaging-channel delivery is a fair question for an agent framework, but nothing in the evidence documents any WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack or iMessage integration. The closest items, routing webhook or polling events into agent threads and shipping agents as standalone endpoints or inside React/Node apps, are developer building blocks rather than built-in messenger surfaces. They earn no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
